questions.questionText: Who developed C++?
questions.explanation: C++ was developed by Bjarne Stroustrup at Bell Labs.

questions.questionText: C++ was originally developed as an extension of which language?
questions.explanation: C++ was developed as an extension of the C programming language.

questions.questionText: Which symbol is used to end a statement in C++?
questions.explanation: A semicolon (;) is generally used to terminate a statement in C++.

questions.questionText: Which function is the entry point of a C++ program?
questions.explanation: Execution of a standard C++ program begins from the main() function.

questions.questionText: Which header file is commonly used for input and output using cin and cout?
questions.explanation: The <iostream> header provides standard input and output streams such as cin and cout.

questions.questionText: Which object is used for standard output in C++?
questions.explanation: cout is the standard output stream object in C++.

questions.questionText: Which object is used for standard input in C++?
questions.explanation: cin is the standard input stream object in C++.

questions.questionText: Which operator is used with cout to send data to the output stream?
questions.explanation: The insertion operator (<<) is used with cout to send data to the output stream.

questions.questionText: Which operator is used with cin to receive data from the input stream?
questions.explanation: The extraction operator (>>) is used with cin to read input.

questions.questionText: Which keyword is used to declare a constant variable in C++?
questions.explanation: The const keyword makes a variable read-only after initialization.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a valid C++ variable declaration?
questions.explanation: int age; is a valid declaration of an integer variable named age.

questions.questionText: Which data type is used to store a single character in C++?
questions.explanation: The char data type is used to store a single character.

questions.questionText: Which data type is used to store true or false values?
questions.explanation: C++ provides the bool data type for true and false values.

questions.questionText: Which keyword is used to define a user-defined data type using a class?
questions.explanation: The class keyword is used to define a class in C++.

questions.questionText: Which keyword is used to define a structure in C++?
questions.explanation: The struct keyword is used to define a structure in C++.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a valid single-line comment in C++?
questions.explanation: A double slash (//) starts a single-line comment in C++.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a valid multi-line comment in C++?
questions.explanation: C-style multi-line comments are written between /* and */.

questions.questionText: Which keyword is commonly used to bring names from the std namespace into the current scope?
questions.explanation: using namespace std; makes names from the std namespace directly accessible.

questions.questionText: Which namespace contains standard C++ library components such as cout and cin?
questions.explanation: Standard C++ library components such as cout and cin belong to the std namespace.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is NOT a fundamental data type in C++?
questions.explanation: string is a standard library class/type, not a fundamental built-in data type like int, char, and float.

questions.questionText: What is the correct syntax to declare a floating-point variable?
questions.explanation: The float keyword is used to declare a single-precision floating-point variable.

questions.questionText: Which keyword is used to return a value from a function?
questions.explanation: The return statement sends a value back from a function to its caller.

questions.questionText: What is the output of the following code? int x = 10; cout << x;
questions.explanation: The value stored in x is 10, so cout << x displays 10.

questions.questionText: What is the output of the following code? cout << "Hello";
questions.explanation: Text inside double quotes is printed without the quotation marks.

questions.questionText: Which symbol is used to access members of an object in C++?
questions.explanation: The dot (.) operator is used to access members of an object. The -> operator is commonly used with pointers to objects.
